decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in consecutive years and is publicly promoted on the website, so the visible success and commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning of the other new breads, still has its own page, and fits the firm's traditional bread identity, so management will persist with it.
The marzipan stollen sits next to the award-winning stollen line in the seasonal assortment and kept its own page in 2024, so it remains central to the firm's announced Christmas offer.
